description:
Use this tool when the user asks for performance metrics or analytics for a published social media post.

It retrieves the latest available performance insights and associated credit information for the specified published post.

It requires the public publish_url returned after a successful posts.publish_post operation. It works only for supported social networks and account types with tracking enabled.

Available metrics depend on the social network, account type, published post, tracking availability, and data returned by the endpoint. Not all metrics are available for every post or network.

Report only metrics actually returned by the server. Do not interpret missing metrics as zero or invent unavailable performance data.

The request may deduct credits according to the account and network pricing. Consider the credit cost before making the request.

post_url.description: Public URL of the published post whose insights should be retrieved.

name: posts.insights
title: Retrieve published post performance insights
